about: Crow's triage of each finding of Zero Cool's scan (2026-11-18) and fix review (2026-11-19), keyed by the first 8 characters of the finding's artifact ID. rating: Crow's own severity. outcome: confirmed (a new defect), known (already in Crow's own records), not a defect. status: what Crow did. review: the fix review's verdict on the change that answers the finding; empty where no change answers it. table.mjs renders docs/audit/outside-scan.md's table from this file and the redacted data; tests/outside-scan.test.ts checks that every finding has a row.

30145111.note: A contract cannot know its chain's slot time; the deploy script sets the margin for the chain.

67531304.note: Change (e): a primary's decision must carry empty beacon fields, and an escalation decision no appeal ground.

3ed7c89a.note: Its High part, the key on a refunded deal, was fixed before the scan (PR 125); the limit is as a0cd835b.

a0cd835b.note: known-issues.md, H-2 limit. Closing it on chain needs a commit and reveal of the key, a new protocol step (D26).

30c0020e.note: The deal goes to the fallback or the default its terms name. The bound the docs stated was too narrow (see da30d5b8) and is corrected.

696fcaca.note: known-issues.md OS-1. Crow's operators post every delivery on its own and carry one only in an accept (T-526); the contract path is unchanged, so a direct relayer can still carry one.

da30d5b8.note: known-issues.md OS-2. The scan marks it a duplicate of 696fcaca. The docs' bound for contract signers is corrected.

1661b40c.note: Needs a deployer's mistake. deploy-sepolia.sh --check compares the deployed code with the record.

4989a790.note: Change (a): the constructor asks the beacon for a round and refuses with BadBeacon. The residual is bf7f2cb1.

babd6d40.note: No lower bound is needed; the deploy script sets the value for the chain.

3a373655.note: Change (b): the pairing gas is set at deploy, with a floor of 102,900 gas.

93457d96.note: EIP-2537 makes the precompile check the subgroup. A mainnet gate item runs the test vectors on every client.

069b8a2b.note: No deal can name a time before the beacon's genesis.

0ac9ec26.note: Change (c): a call that ran short of gas reverts NotEnoughGas, not InvalidSignature.

0b642051.note: The cost is the sender's own gas.

cdae1d18.note: The cost is the sender's own gas.

008bef5f.note: Change (d): funding refuses terms whose three dispute fields are not zero.

3dec9493.note: known-issues.md OS-3. Needs two contract wallets that accept one shared key. The signed settlement gains the signer's address in the rebuilt contracts.

90744dd1.note: known-issues.md DS-1. Bounded by the parties' own choice of primary adjudicator.

1aea5848.note: Fixed before the scan; the residual adds nothing to DS-1.

2dd4fb70.note: Needs three colluding proposer slots. A mainnet gate item measures it.

8a875efc.note: known-issues.md OS-4. The docs now state n - 2 known draws for a run of n slots; the design change waits for the mainnet gate.

cdf06aaa.note: Change (f): the comment on the escrow expiry's 48-bit bound is corrected.

5c7d4a2f.note: Phase one has no appeals and no bonds (D57, ADR-0031). Bounded by one deal's price and fee.

e33be4dc.note: As 5c7d4a2f. A per-deal cap is a mainnet gate item (ADR-0034).

051d0f3e.note: Both parties sign the payout addresses.

25127f2a.note: By design: both parties sign the late-work settlement.

2adb1339.note: Escrow behaviour; nothing can use the amount.

5e3efbe5.note: The seller protects itself by posting its delivery (D32).

6d458080.note: A token issuer's control over its own token; out of scope.

714ab9c7.note: A trust assumption on the token.

72ae5dbd.note: A wallet deploys before it funds; the agent docs say so.

93eba475.note: The parties choose the adjudicators; bonds and appeals return later.

aeb9c2ff.note: The contract sees only hashes; the buyer's own check refuses such a delivery.

aef7f785.note: Anyone may trigger a timeout; one live party is enough.

c1a83183.note: The prepare call cannot reach money.

c39d470a.note: The case goes to the fallback or the default.

e30c079b.note: Operator code, fixed on main before the scan (T-409, PR 512).

542b89b8.note: Operator code, fixed on main before the scan (T-409, PR 512).

c65cd6d5.note: Operator code, fixed on main before the scan (T-409, PR 512).
